resources.string: The executor for this cloud operation is not connected on Android yet. No change or transfer was performed.

Only metadata in the currently loaded folder, not total cloud storage.
Legacy local queue records; pause on this page only saves a flag. For actual Telegram downloads, open Cloud Drives → Cloud downloads. Legacy records never run automatically.

Information about this device. Sign-in and Telegram API configuration are available on the Accounts page. Backup, cache cleanup, and worker settings are not integrated; this page does not request credentials.
Collection from the currently loaded Drive metadata. Album creation, transcoding, and Telegram sending have no Android executor yet.
Choose a device file using the system picker. The player reads the file you grant access to; this is not Telegram preview or a crawler.
Unable to open content. Access may have expired or the format may be unsupported.
Internal preview does not support this file type yet.
At most 256 KiB of text is displayed; the original file is unchanged.
